billing.description: How an account is paid for (`Account.billing`).

status.description: Whether a project or an account is in use (`status`).

Account.description: `Account`. `windows` are the provider windows an engine last reported.

AccountUpdate.description: `AccountUpdate`, for the account the path names.

AdminRecord.description:
One of the admin plane's events (admin_events.hl), as the hub tells it:
its id and time as the event stream's, and its `data` as JSON text.
Every instance's hub follows the store's rows (`AdminFeed`), so each
tells what any instance recorded. A `data` past what one bus frame
carries is sent as `null`, `whole` false, and read whole instead.

ApplyStep.description:
`ApplyStep`: one step of a plan carried out: removing a placement,
adding a catalog model or a placement, pointing an alias.

Arrangement.description:
`Arrangement`: wants kept, when they were last planned, and whether the
fleet has changed since.

outcome.description:
How applying a plan came out: all done; stopped at a step that failed;
or not begun, the plan no longer what the fleet would get.

ArrangementApplied.description:
`ArrangementApplied`: each step and what it came to, what to do next,
and, when the plan had drifted, the fresh plan.

ArrangementApply.description:
`ArrangementApply`: a plan to carry out, the wants it was made for, the
account the seats it adds spend, and the project whose aliases it
points.

ArrangementPin.description:
`ArrangementPin`: a model on `count` nodes, the ones named or any; two
are a pair cabled to each other, the model split across them.

ArrangementRole.description:
A role an arrangement may ask voice to fill (`ArrangementRole`): its
name, how the UI shows it, the alias it points, and the recipes that can
fill it, the strongest first.

ArrangementRoleWant.description:
`ArrangementRoleWant`: a role to fill, `count` times; `priority` 1 is
filled first, and a role with none after those with one.

outcome.description: How one seat's attempt at a request ended (`Attempt.outcome`).

Attempt.description:
`Attempt`. `error` "" when it served; nothing is counted yet, so no
output is known before a failure.

period.description:
How often a budget resets (`BudgetSet.period`); `none` is a lifetime
cap.

Budget.description:
`Budget`: the allowance in its current window. `window_end` is `null`
for a lifetime cap.

period.description:
How often a budget resets (`BudgetSet.period`); `none` is a lifetime
cap.

BudgetInput.description:
`BudgetSet` as a request gives it. One that names no `period_anchor`
counts from the start of the current calendar period.

period.description:
How often a budget resets (`BudgetSet.period`); `none` is a lifetime
cap.

BudgetRequest.description: `PUT .../budget`: the `BudgetSet` for the project the path names.

contract.description:
What a model answers (decision.hl): text, or a decision over the
choices a request's schema names.

anyOf.description:
What a model answers (decision.hl): text, or a decision over the
choices a request's schema names.

contract.description:
What a model answers (decision.hl): text, or a decision over the
choices a request's schema names.

CatalogModelCreate.description:
`CatalogModelCreate`. A count of 0 is not set; no `price` (or `null`)
is free; with no `kind` it is `local`.

anyOf.description:
What a model answers (decision.hl): text, or a decision over the
choices a request's schema names.

contract.description:
What a model answers (decision.hl): text, or a decision over the
choices a request's schema names.

CatalogModelUpdate.description:
`CatalogModelUpdate`, for the model the path names: only the fields
whose `set_` flag is true change.

Change.description:
`Change`, as the surface describes it: `before` and `after` the
resource's JSON, free-form, or `null`. `getChange` answers it.

ChangeAsk.description:
`listChanges`' query: the times are RFC 3339 text, read when the handler
runs so a bad one is refused by name.

ChangeList.description:
A page of changes, at most `CHANGE_PAGE_MAX`; `next_cursor` is `null` on
the last.

ChangeRef.description: Which change: the `{change}` of the path.

ChangeSummary.description:
`ChangeSummary`: a change as `listChanges` lists it, without the
resource it holds (`getChange` has it).

ConversationUsageAsk.description:
`GET /admin/v1/usage/conversations`'s filters, as `UsageAsk`'s, and
only conversations with a failed request when `has_failures`.

ConversationUsageList.description:
A page of conversations, the most recently active first, at most
`USAGE_PAGE_MAX`; `next_cursor` is `null` on the last.

EngineArchive.description:
`RuntimeCreate.artifact.archive`: the engine a container runs, built
apart from its image, as a tarball by sha256.

FetchProgress.description: `FetchProgress` (protocol.yaml): how far a managed seat's fetch is.

FitNode.description:
`FitNode`: a node models are placed on, as a fit is judged against it:
the memory its models are served from (its first accelerator's: a GPU's
own, or the machine's when that GPU shares it, or it has none), what
models may use of it and what its placements hold, its disk free; or why
no model can be placed on it.

FitPair.description:
`FitPair`: two nodes cabled to each other, which a model may be split
across, the first its leader; or why none can be.

kind.description:
`FitSpeed.kind`: measured on voice's own requests, or estimated from the
hardware.

FitSpeed.description: `FitSpeed`: tokens a second, one request at a time.

Health.description:
`Health`. `checks` is each dependency's state on readiness, a map of
values (`{"store": "ok"}`); liveness has none.

InstanceReport.description: An api instance's heartbeat: it is alive at `at`.

status.description: Whether a key may be used (`Key.status`).

Key.description:
`Key`, and `KeyWithSecret` when `secret` is set (only the answer to
its creation). A time whose flag is false is `null`.

KeyCreate.description: `KeyCreate` under the project the path names.

KeyUpdate.description: `KeyUpdate`, for the key the path names.

Limit.description:
`Limit`. A count whose `has_` flag is false is `null`: unlimited, and
-1 in the count.

source.description: Where a project's limits come from (`LimitSet.source`).

LimitsRequest.description: `LimitSet`, for the project the path names.

LinkCheck.description: `LinkCheck` (openapi.yaml): a check of the link between two nodes.

LocalControls.description:
`LocalControls`: what the node's operator set on the machine. A node
from before may still send a local `max_in_flight`: it is read past.

ModelAlias.description: One alias: the name a caller asks for, and the catalog model it is.

ModelRef.description: Which model: the `{model}` of the path.

Node.description:
`Node`, as the surface describes it: its capabilities a typed record,
its seats `SeatSummary`s (node_of_read); a seat's config is `getSeat`'s.

NodeAccelerator.description: `Accelerator` (protocol.yaml): one GPU or Apple silicon's, as measured.

NodeAsk.description: `listNodes`' query: a page's size, and the `next_cursor` it follows.

NodeCabledPort.description:
`CabledPort` (protocol.yaml): a port of the machine with an RDMA device
and a carrier, as the node found it (cabling.hl).

NodeCapabilities.description:
`Capabilities` (protocol.yaml): what the node can run, the machine it
runs on when the node measured it, the nodes it is cabled to as its
operator declared them, and its cabled ports as it found them.
A node from before still declares `max_in_flight`, its own cap: it is
read past, as no cap of a node's stands (its capacity is its seats').

NodeDownload.description: `NodeDownload`: one recipe variant, as much of it as the node holds.

NodeDownloaded.description:
`NodeDownloaded`: what a node's store holds, in short, as its summary
carries it: how many files and their size together, from the totals
the store keeps beside its report, so a summary reads no file list.

NodeDownloads.description:
`NodeDownloads`: what a node holds, by variant: those held whole first,
then those held in part, at most `DOWNLOADS_MAX`; then what no variant
listed accounts for.

NodeEngine.description:
`Engine` (protocol.yaml): one engine a node offers. Its `config_schema` is a JSON
Schema, free-form; `models` is `null`, any name, when it is not set.

NodeHardware.description: `Hardware` (protocol.yaml): what the machine has, as the node measured it.

NodeLink.description:
`NodeLink` (openapi.yaml): one link a node has, as the coordinator sees
it: declared, or found from its cabled ports (cabling.hl).

NodeLinkDecl.description: `Link` (protocol.yaml): a peer the node is cabled to, and its ports.

NodeLinkPort.description: `LinkPort` (protocol.yaml): a local port cabled to a peer.

NodeLinkViewPort.description:
One port of a link as the node's view shows it (`NodeLink.ports`): its
address only once it has one to meet on, its RDMA device and its speed
when the node said them.

NodeList.description:
A page of nodes, at most `NODE_PAGE_MAX`, in the order they were
created; `next_cursor` is `null` on the last.

NodeObservation.description:
A node as it now is, after a report it made was recorded: the node as
`GET /admin/v1/nodes` lists it (`NodeSummary`: its hardware, and its
seats without their configs, a managed seat's fetch among them), as
JSON, since the bus carries no list of records within a record.

NodePortGid.description: One RoCE v2 GID of a cabled port (protocol.yaml `CabledPort.gids`).

NodeSuggestion.description:
One category's suggestion: the recipe and the variant that would be
placed, and why; or, when none can be, why not. `placed` names the
placement already serving it there; `downloaded` says the node holds
the variant whole.

NodeSuggestions.description:
`NodeSuggestions`: a node's platform and tier, and a suggestion a
category; and across the node and one it is cabled to, theirs.

NodeSummary.description:
`NodeSummary`: a node as `listNodes` lists it and the hub and the event
stream tell it: its state, the hardware it measured and its seats, each
a `SeatSummary`; not what it declared (`getNode` has it).

NodeUpdate.description: `NodeUpdate`, for the node the path names.

PairSuggestions.description:
`PairSuggestions`: what voice would place across a node and a node it
is cabled to, at their tier together.

PeekAsk.description:
`listPeeks`: a project's, a key's, a model's (the catalog model each
was routed as), all when none; a page's size, and the `next_cursor` it
follows.

PeekList.description: A page of recordings; `next_cursor` is `null` on the last.

PeekSummary.description: A recorded request, listed: its bodies are read with `getPeek`.

PlanAdd.description:
`PlanAdd`: a model placed, in the form placing it would choose: the id
it would be placed as, its variant and runtime, what it would reserve
and hold of each of its nodes' memory for models, what its nodes fetch.
`in_catalog` false when no catalog model names the recipe yet: `model`
is then the recipe's id, the model it would be added as.

PlanAlias.description: `PlanAlias`: the alias a role points, at the model filling it.

PlanDownload.description: `PlanDownload`: what a node fetches for the plan.

PlanKeep.description: `PlanKeep`: a placement left as it is, and the wants it serves.

PlanUnmet.description:
`PlanUnmet`: a want the plan leaves unfilled, and why; and the least
its strongest candidate would hold of each node it needs, when a model
can fill it at all (`least_held`).

PracticeRef.description: The practice a ratified limit was read from.

Problem.description:
What was wrong, in the words of the contract's error object: the `code`,
the `message`, the request field at fault (`param`, when there is one) and,
for a store failure, the incident the api logged it under.

status.description: Whether a project or an account is in use (`status`).

Project.description:
`Project`. `models` and `accounts` are `null`, no restriction, when
their flags are false.

ProjectCreate.description:
`ProjectCreate`. `models` and `accounts` left out or `null` are no
restriction, `budget` no budget.

ProjectUpdate.description: `ProjectUpdate`, for the project the path names.

QuotaWindow.description:
`QuotaWindow`: a limit the provider enforces on the account, as an
engine last reported it.

RuntimeCreate.description: `RuntimeCreate`. `server` is one the node knows how to start (`SERVERS`).

RuntimeList.description: Voice's own (at most `SHIPPED_MAX`) and the operator's (the store's 64).

RuntimePlatform.description: One platform a runtime runs on.

SeatCreate.description:
`Seat`, as created on the node the path names. `config` is the engine's
JSON object, free-form: its `config_schema` says it.

SeatList.description: A node's seats, at most 16 (`createSeat`), each a `SeatSummary`.

SeatModel.description:
`SeatModel`. `engine_name` is its `as` (a word Hale keeps), `null` when
`has_engine_name` is false.

status.description: A seat's state as the admin plane sees it (`SeatView.status`): the node's report, `pending` until the node reports on the assignment that carries it, `offline` while the node is not up.

SeatSummary.description:
`SeatSummary`: a seat as a node and its lists carry it, without its
`config` (`getSeat` has it); a placement's seat with the placement, the
variant and the runtime its config names, and the context its model is
made for.

SeatUpdate.description: `SeatUpdate`, for the seat the path names.

status.description: A seat's state as the admin plane sees it (`SeatView.status`): the node's report, `pending` until the node reports on the assignment that carries it, `offline` while the node is not up.

SeatView.description:
`SeatView`, as the surface describes it: its config a `std::json::Value`
(seat_view_of).

TargetFit.description: `TargetFit`: one variant judged on a node or a pair.

UsageAsk.description:
The filters `GET /admin/v1/usage` takes. The times are RFC 3339 text and
`metadata` one `name=value` pair or a JSON object of several
(`metadata_pairs`), read when the handler runs so a bad one is refused by
name.

UsageGroupOut.description: One group of a summary: `group` keys the `group_by` fields.

UsageList.description:
A page of the ledger, newest first, at most `USAGE_PAGE_MAX`;
`next_cursor` is `null` on the last.

UsageRecord.description:
`UsageRecord`: one request, as the ledger holds it. A row is read from
the record the store keeps whole (`UsageRow.record`), which is this
shape as JSON; `metadata` is the caller's own object, untouched.

UsageRecordSummary.description:
`UsageRecordSummary`: a request as `listUsage` lists it, without its
attempts or the caller's `metadata` (`getUsage` has them both); an
internal request's own `annotates` and `side`, from its metadata.

UsageRef.description: Which request: the `{request_id}` of the path.

UsageSummaryAsk.description: `GET /admin/v1/usage/summary`'s: the same filters, and the fields to group by.

UsageTiming.description: How long a request took, in `UsageRecord.timing`.

UsageTotal.description: `UsageTotal`: one group's totals in one currency (st::UsageTotal).

UsageTotals.description:
`UsageTotals`: the hours counted, from the start of the first to the
end of the last, and a row per group.

UsageTotalsAsk.description:
`GET /admin/v1/usage/totals`'s: the fields to group by (any of project,
key, model) and the filters the hourly rollup keeps.

VariantFit.description: `VariantFit`: one variant, judged against the nodes.

VariantFits.description: `VariantFits`: a variant, judged on every node and pair.

notes.inventory: every exposure with its listener, its sources and its receivers: a deployment inventory, never an authorization statement for any caller
notes.authorization: requires is checked against this exposure's role source at the serve site, before a request is queued: a boundary check, never a proof over the program's internal call paths
notes.lifecycle: a request accepted runs to completion: a timeout or a lost connection does not mean it did not run, and ending the wait never rolls it back
